dataFlow: The project uses the Spring Boot Starter Parent version 3.2.4, which may contain known vulnerabilities. This version is propagated through the dependencies defined in the pom.xml, potentially leading to insecure behavior in the application.
rootCause: The root cause is the use of an outdated version of the Spring Boot Starter Parent (3.2.4) specified on line 12, which may have known vulnerabilities that can be exploited.
securityImpact: The use of a vulnerable dependency can lead to unauthorized access, data breaches, and potential denial of service, impacting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the application.
proposedFix: Update the version of the Spring Boot Starter Parent to the latest stable release to mitigate known vulnerabilities.
summary: The application is vulnerable due to the use of an outdated Spring Boot Starter Parent version, which may expose it to security risks.
